name: smart-shoots-mobile
description: SMART SHOOTS wrapped as a native Android app (Capacitor) - talks to the same Django backend over the local network.

scripts.build:apk: npm run clean && npm run prebuild:frontend && npm run verify && npx cap sync android && cd android && (test -f gradlew.bat && gradlew.bat assembleDebug || ./gradlew assembleDebug)
